page_title: CEL 1-2 BAR | Celta Vigo v Barcelona 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+10' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+9' Here comes a substitution. Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) is brought on as a substitute for Lamine Yamal.
90+7' 1 - 2 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) takes just a short run up and buries the penalty into the bottom right corner.
90+7' Barcelona will get another bite of the cherry as the referee indicates the penalty must be taken again!
90+6' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the right post, but Vicente Guaita leaps out to thwart his attempt.
90+5' It's a yellow card for Marc-Andre ter Stegen (Barcelona).
90+5' Although Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) is just on the bench, Juan Pulido has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+4' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is going to take the penalty!
90+4' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+3' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Juan Pulido signals. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Barcelona!
90+1' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
85' Here is a change. Oscar Mingueza is going off and Rafael Benitez gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo).
85' Substitution. Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jorgen Strand Larsen walks off.
84' Celta Vigo earn a corner.
81' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
80' Juan Pulido blows the whistle, Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is penalised for a foul.
79' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
77' Rafael Benitez prepares a substitution. Tadeo Allende is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
77' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
75' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pedri.
75' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
74' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
71' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
67' Raphinha (Barcelona) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.

66' What a poor attempt! Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
65' The corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is intercepted by the defence.
65' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the mid-range free kick and sends it towards the roof of the net, but he is denied by the goalkeeper. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Juan Pulido blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Barcelona.
61' One of the Barcelona players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
60' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
59' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch because Mihailo Ristic simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
58' Xavi has decided to make a change. Raphinha (Barcelona) replaces Vitor Roque.
58' Substitution. Andreas Christensen leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona).
57' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Vicente Guaita comes off his line to gather the ball.
56' Celta Vigo are ruled offside.
54' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
51' The attendance is 23096.
50' Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
47' 1 - 1 Goal! Oscar Mingueza passes the ball to Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Marc-Andre ter Stegen couldn't do anything about it. 1:1.
46' Half-time substitution. Xavi decided to make a change. Ronald Araujo is replaced by Inigo Martinez (Barcelona).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Rafael Benitez gives a chance to Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) and Carlos Dominguez is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Juan Pulido blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' 0 - 1 Goal! Lamine Yamal shows great vision to find Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 0:1.
44' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but Vicente Guaita punches the ball away.
42' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
39' The game is interrupted now, Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
38' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Andreas Christensen (Barcelona).
37' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
37' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
35' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
35' A cross from Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Now Barcelona have a corner.
32' Barcelona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
28' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
27' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.

26' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
22' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
21' One of the Barcelona players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
20' Pedri (Barcelona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
19' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
15' Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) gets a yellow card.
15' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
15' Good work from Celta Vigo as they win a corner.
15' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
13' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and signals a foul after Pedri (Barcelona) brought his opponent down.
12' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) unleashes a close-range volley low towards the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains unchanged.
10' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.

10' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Vicente Guaita thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
9' Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) is caught offside!
7' Celta Vigo concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
6' Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) jumps into a tackle and Juan Pulido signals a foul.
3' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
2' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Pulido who sees an offensive foul.
1' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Barcelona will have the kick-off.
Juan Pulido is the one to supervise the game today.
